entities.name: PMID:25073029
observations: In a kidney-transplant cohort, pretransplant low-serum MBL was associated with more inflammation and tubular apoptosis in surveillance biopsies within six months; adequate biopsy tissue was available for 41 of 126 recipients.

entities.name: MBL
observations: Serum mannose-binding lectin measured before kidney transplantation; the study classified its lowest tertile as low MBL.

entities.name: Low MBL biopsy inflammation
observations: In the 41 adequate early surveillance biopsies, low pretransplant MBL was associated with higher acute Banff index (3.14±1.96 vs 1.88±1.56; p=0.044), more tubular apoptosis (4.3±3.6 vs 0.2±0.9; p=0.012), and more interstitial macrophages (109±118 vs 32±46 cells/mm²; p=0.04), compared with high MBL.
